notes: The head of set feasts is the verse's one genuine tie; feasts is taken as the class noun the ASV writes for words of that class and set as its specifier, with the rule 31 alternative named in the unit note.
The apodosis waw before ye shall blow is unrendered and so `unrepresented` rather than folded into the verb (rule 14).
burnt offerings and peace offerings both head on the modifier under rule 31, offerings alone being any offering.
אֲנִי takes only its own I and the copula joins the written predicate (rule 20).
